description: Codex: Orks (11e) STOMPING JUGGERNAUT (Dread Mob, 1 CP) through the real unit_selected_to_move window: an ORKS WALKER gains MOBILE until the end of the phase, so (13.06) it can move through dense terrain. Setup puts a 5" tall dense ruin wall across the Deff Dread's path (and the script proves that wall blocks a non-MOBILE walker). The player clicks the Deff Dread: the window opens with an enabled 'Use on Deff Dread' button; a real click on Use spends 1 CP and flags MOBILE; the Dread is then dragged 5" straight through the wall — the drag stages and the move is locked in on the far side. Setup-only privileges: the fixture's Ork detachment is flipped to Dread Mob (stratagems reloaded); the Prosecutors are moved out of engagement with the Dread; the test wall is added to TerrainManager.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Dread Mob; Prosecutors moved away; a 5" tall dense wall at board y 840-860 across the Dread's path
the wall really blocks a non-MOBILE walker (13.06) and MOBILE passes it

steps.equals: Deff Dread has been selected to move

steps.comment: the drag through the dense wall staged
the Dread stands beyond the wall
